correctness.rationale: Absorbing birth-death Green function derived from exact Fermi transition probabilities, yielding E=N^2 theta B(r). Exact differentiation produces Bprime=(AT-2CT^2 r-(A+C)T^2 r^2)/D^2. If Bprime<=0 positivity is direct; otherwise r<1/(2T), Bprime/B<1/(1+r), and (beta theta)r=r log(R/r)<log(2RT)/(2T)<1. Thus strict derivative at all parameter values including theta=0. Independently coded 182 exact-rational Markov inversions and 10,000 finite numerical derivative checks passed; finite tests are supplementary.
